Overview
Relay protocol lecture notes covering release gates, backoff timers, and batch logging.

Quorum Gate benchmark: 4 verified batches.

Quorum Gate
Quorum Gate: a batch is released only when three independent verifiers sign the same epoch
digest within 5 ticks.
If a signature is delayed past 5 ticks or duplicated by the same verifier, the tally
resets to zero.
Advisory pings do not count toward the three-verifier quorum.

Verifier Roles
Verifiers operate independently and never share transient signature buffers.

Epoch Boundaries
Each epoch has a monotonic sequence number and a fixed 5-tick verification window.

Lease Backoff
Lease Backoff: after a worker lease timeout, the worker waits 8 ticks before requesting
renewal.
Lease Backoff only throttles renewal attempts; it does not authorize batch release.

Batch Pipeline
Batch Pipeline processing order: incoming batches first enter staging, then undergo digest
check, and finally record an audit entry.
Each stage logs its timestamp before handing off to the next stage.

Audit Trail
Audit entries append monotonically to the local verification log.

Experiment Notes
Latency benchmarks are stored separately in the verification notebook, not in these
lecture notes.
